title: Stasis Grove
description: A vibrant fantasy map illustration of an enchanted circular grove centered around a massive glowing purple crystal tree. The scene features winding stone paths connecting a flower-filled archway, a fountain, a wooden market stall, a red hot air balloon, a lava and stump area with a mine entrance, and a purple pond zone with lily pads.
prompt: Whimsical fantasy map illustration of a circular grove with a giant glowing purple crystal tree on a turquoise tiled base at the center. Winding stone paths connect various themed areas including a pink flower archway with fountain, a wooden market stall with balloons, lush green trees, a wooden bridge over a purple pond zone filled with lily pads and glowing water, and a volcanic area with lava, tree stumps, and a dark mine entrance. Bright cartoon style with rich colors and clear pathways.
